tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅: dur khrod brgyad kyi byin 'beb bkol byang bzhugs so:

ྈྈྈ ma hā shrī he ru ka la na mo: sgrub pa chen po'i byin dbab pa'i skabs su dur khrod brgyad kyi rig 'dzin lha dang mkha' 'gros kyang byin dbab par bya ste: hūm̐: byin chen ngo mtshar khyad par gnas: ru dra'i snying dang stobs bzang ro: shar phyogs dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal: nya shing gon pa'i zhing skyong ni: gnam 'phro dkar po glang mgo can: gri gug thod khrag phyag na bsnams: phyogs skyong brgya byin sku mdog ser: glang chen steng na rdo rje bsnams: mtsho nang mtha' yas klu dbang dkar: sbrul mgo gdengs shing thal mo sbyar: chu sprin dkar la shing sdong ser: mchod rten mdangs ldan bde byed brtsegs: ke'u ri bhan dmar byis dbyug mthing: ma mo chen mo gshegs su gsol: ston pa mkhas shing snying stobs che: hūm̐ kā ra yis byin phob cig: gu ru de ba ḍā ki nī sarba hrīṃ hrīṃ ā: hūm̐: byin chen ngo mtshar khyad par gnas: lha chen mgo dang 'chi bdag ro: lho phyogs dur khrod sku la rdzogs: shing chen bkra sha'i tsu dha sngo: zhing skyong 'tsho byed ma he'i gdong: phyogs skyong gshin rje sngo nag brjid: thod dbyug thogs nas ma he zhon: klu chen 'jog po gser mtsho 'dzin: sprin chen rnam sdud sngo skya 'khyil: mchod rten ta la rin chen brtsegs: tso'u ri mda' gzhu 'geng ma ser: ma mo chen mo gshegs su gsol: ston pa rang byung rdzu 'phrul ldan: 'jam dpal gshes gnyen byin phob cig: gu ru de ba ḍā ki nī sarba hrīṃ hrīṃ ā: hūm̐: byin chen ngo mtshar khyad par gnas: lha chen nang khrol stobs bzang ro: nub phyogs dur khrod lang ka brtsegs: shing chen a ta a li kaḥ zhing skyong rol chen chu srin gdong: phyogs skyong chu lha dmar skya sbrul: chung ma dang bcas chu srin zhon: klu rgyal dung skyong mtsho dmar skya: sprin sgrog 'thibs pa dmar nag 'khrug: mchod rten bde rgyas khams sum sgrol:

pra mo chu srin rgyal mtshan dmar: ma mo chen mo gshegs su gsol: ston pa chos 'chad 'byor pa ldan: klu sgrub snying pos byin phob cig: gu ru dhe ba ḍā ki nī sarba hrīṃ hrīṃ ā: hūm̐: byin chen ngo mtshar khyad par gnas: lha chen mtshan ma khyab 'jug ro: byang phyogs dur khrod pad+ma brtsegs: a su sta na mdzes pa'i shing: zhing skyong dud kha rta mgo ljang: phyogs skyong gnod sbyin dbyug tho bsnams: chung mar bcas te rta dmar zhon: klu rgyal stobs rgyu mtsho chen ljang: rmug byed myos sprin ljang gur 'thibs: mchod rten don yod phrin las gter: bai tā mthing ga rdo rje phyar: ma mo chen mo gshegs su gsol: ston pa myang 'das mthu rtsal che: pra chen hastis byin phob cig: gu ru dhe ba ḍā ki nī sarba hrīṃ hrīṃ ā: hūm̐: byin chen ngo mtshar khyad par gnas: lha chen lag g.yas dga' dbang rau: shar lho dur khrod lhun grub gter: shing chen nag skya kro ta bzang: zhing skyong 'dungs pa ra gdong ser: phyogs skyong me lha zhugs bum can: chung ma dang bcas ra la zhon: klu rgyal pad chen mtsho chen sngo: gdug byed sprin chen dmar ser 'khyil: mchod rten go'u ti shan+ti: puska dmar ser byis rgyu 'dren: ma mo chen mo gshegs su gsol: ston pa rol rtsed zas bcud che: bi ma mi tras byin phob cig: gu ru dhe ba ḍā ki nī sarba hrīṃ hrīṃ ā: hūm̐: byin chen ngo mtshar khyad par gnas: lha chen lag g.yon tshogs bdag ro: lho nub dur khrod gsang chen rol: shing chen bzhi khri rdzogs ldan 'od: zhing skyong sprul pa mi gdong sngo: phyogs skyong srin po gri thogs smug: chung mar bcas te ro la zhon: klu chen hu lca mtsho bcas smug: sprin chen dha na ser khrar 'khyil: mchod rten rmang grangs ka ni ka: kasma dung dmar dkrugs 'thung ljang: ma mo chen mo gshegs su gsol: ston pa bdud 'dul byin rlabs gnas:

dha na saṃskris byin phob cig: gu ru dhe ba ḍā ki nī sarba hrīṃ hrīṃ ā: hūm̐: byin chen ngo mtshar khyad par gnas: lha chen rkang g.yon bhṛṃ ga'i ro: nub byang dur khrod he chen brdal: shing chen tardza nag po ste: zhing skyong lto 'phye sha ba'i mgo: phyogs skyong rlung lha ba dan can: dud kha chung bcas sha ba zhon: klu chen rigs ldan mtsho bcas ljang: sprin pa rab chad char 'beb ser: mchod rten bde ldan ma hā 'bab: sme sha nag mo tsit+ta za: ma mo chen mo gshegs su gsol: ston pa khab bzhes btsun mor ldan: rom+bu gu h+yas byin phob cig: gu ru dhe ba ḍā ki nī sarba hrīṃ hrīṃ ā: hūm̐: byin chen ngo mtshar khyad par gnas: lha chen rkang g.yas smin drug ro: byang shar dur khrod 'jig rten brtsegs: shing chen ha la 'od dmar 'khyil: zhing skyong dregs pa ce spyang gdong: dbang ldan ljang skya rtse gsum can: chung mar bcas te ce spyang zhon: klu chen ba su mtsho bcas dkar: sprin chen nya can nag po 'khrug: mchod rten klu gnas shing kun ste: tsan+dha ser skya mchog lus 'bral: ma mo chen mo gshegs su gsol: ston pa cho 'phrul bzo la mkhas: shān+tiṃ gar+bhas byin phob cig: gu ru de ba ḍā ki nī sarba hrīṃ hrīṃ ā: hūm̐: byin chen ngo mtshar khyad par gnas: phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad dur khrod bdag: zhing skyong ma mo kun kyi rje: rig 'dzin grub thob kun gyi gtsug: klu sogs sde brgyad kun gyi gnyen: mchod rten shing chen kun tu bzhugs: o rgyan pad+mas byin phob cig: ma mo mkha' 'gro gshegs su gsol: gnas 'dir byin phob bdag dbang skur: bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: gu ru de ba ḍā ki nī sarba hrīṃ hrīṃ a ā: zhes gdung ba drag pos gsol ba gdab cing: dal bskor zhing byin dbab bo: byin 'beb bkol byang : sa ma ya: dur khrod de dag gi bkod pa ni gshin rje gsal shing gi rgyud las btus shing:

sgrub chen rig 'dzin brgyad po de dag gi ni: dur khrod brgyad du byon nas bka' brgyad bye brag tu sgrub pas dngos grub so sor rnyed cing: dur khrod de dag gi phyogs skyong zhing skyong dang grub thob: ma mo mkha' 'gro thams cad kyis rig 'dzin rnams kyi grogs su zhal bzhes: rjes 'jug skyong bar dbyar dam bcas phyir: dkyil 'khor du bkod pa dang: byin chen dbab par shes so: o rgyan gyis ni dur khrod kun tu khyab par byon cing dngos grub thams cad brnyes pa'i phyir: byin dbang du gsal du shes so: rnal 'byor pa rnams dal la bskor zhing spyi blug gi zhwa dang: zhing lpags g.yab cing mchong stabs bya: byin phob cig ces pa'i skabs su rnga sogs sgra thams cad bsgrag par bya'o: gu ru chos dbang gi gter kha'o// //
